name: ALTER EGO [BETA]
desc:
⚠️ THIS GAME IS IN BETA! ANTICIPATE REGULAR PATCHES AND CHANGES! Please report any bugs or suggestions in our server! ⚠️

An unknown entity known as The Ego has trapped souls inside it's domain, The Labyrinth. You and your team must complete objectives, and escape before losing yourself to ego death. Will you face your sins and save the SOUL?

v0.8.7
• Fixed Persistent Ragdoll immunity via Husk Grab
• Fixed accessories not transforming with bones during ragdoll

💻[CONTROLS]:
[Shift]: Sprint
[Space]: Vault
[X]: Taunt
[Ctrl]: Mouse lock

💰 Want to support the team? Join the Paradoxum Games group and purchase the 'Early Supporter' game pass to unlock exclusive skins and a special chat tag to stand out!
👍 Make sure to leave a like and invite your friends to play! 👍
